search_query.description: the paper-search query for the direction: words joined with `+`, a phrase inside double quotes; a paper must contain every word and phrase

status.description: agent-owned: `active` directions are listed; a `retired` one fell below the leave bar of the selection rule, is kept with its text and comes back when its keywords qualify again; a record without the field is active

quote.description: agent-owned: the span of a source abstract the model-written text rests on; only on a record whose text a model wrote before 2.3, with one quote for the whole text

quotes.description: agent-owned: one span of a source abstract per sentence of the model-written text, in sentence order; only on a record whose text a model wrote

review.description: agent-owned: the Critic's score, the reviewing model and the prompt versions; only on a record whose text a model wrote

generated_by.description: agent-owned: the job, run, provider, model and prompt version that wrote the text; only on a record whose text a model wrote

origin.description: agent-owned: the OpenAlex keywords the direction stands for; written once, when the direction is first listed

keyword_ids.description: short OpenAlex keyword IDs, the one that names the direction first; `https://openalex.org/keywords/<id>` is the keyword's page

keyword_names.description: the keywords as OpenAlex displays them, in the order of `keyword_ids`

first_seen.description: the day the direction was first tied to its keywords

selection.description: agent-owned: the OpenAlex work counts of the direction's keywords, the rule they were judged by and the runs spent below the leave bar, written by code; absent until the first run of the rule

works_recent.description: arXiv-primary works carrying one of `origin.keyword_ids`, published in the latest window; a work with two of the keywords counts twice, and a keyword outside OpenAlex's 200 largest counts as 0

works_previous.description: the same count in the window before

field_recent.description: every arXiv-primary work of the counted OpenAlex topics in the latest window

field_previous.description: the same count in the window before

window_days.description: length of each window in days

min_recent_papers.description: the rule: fewest `works_recent` of a keyword group that enters the list

max_field_share.description: the rule: largest `works_recent / field_recent` of a keyword group that enters the list

leave_below_ratio.description: the rule: the leave bar is this share of `min_recent_papers`

leave_after_runs.description: the rule: runs in a row below the leave bar that retire a direction

runs_below.description: runs in a row the direction was below the leave bar, as of the latest run

observed_at.description: the day the counts were read; refreshed only when a figure changed

activity.description: agent-owned: arXiv paper counts for `search_query`, the rule they were judged by and the verdict, written by code; absent until the first count

papers_recent.description: papers matching `search_query` submitted in the latest window

papers_previous.description: the same count in the window before

field_recent.description: every paper of the counted arXiv categories in the latest window, the field the direction is compared with

field_previous.description: the same count in the window before

window_days.description: length of each window in days

min_papers_high_volume.description: the rule, high volume: `papers_recent` that make a direction hot whatever its growth; absent on a block written before 2.1, which was judged by the rising rule alone

min_papers.description: the rule, rising: fewest `papers_recent` a direction that is hot by its growth has

min_growth_vs_field.description: the rule, rising: how many times the field's growth (`field_recent / field_previous`) the direction's growth (`papers_recent / papers_previous`) is, at least

is_hot.description: the verdict of the rule on these counts

observed_at.description: the day the counts were read; refreshed only when a figure changed

source.description: the arXiv API address that gave `papers_recent`; it states the query, the categories and the window
